Replaces Grenade Ability with Barri-Nade on Class Ability Usage. Barri-Nade is lost if Class Ability fully recharges.

Barri-Nade spawns your selected Barricade type on the impact location and inherits the benefits of Aspects such as Bastion and Drengr's Lash.

Non-barricade class abilities default to Towering Barricade. Barri-nade has no collision with enemies.

Enemies within 5? meters of the impact location are disoriented.

Enemies within 5? meters of the Barri-Nade's impact location are disoriented. Spawned Barricade deals no Contact Damage within 2 seconds of its creation.

Barri-nade has no collision with enemies and objects that are not part of the map by default.
